messages:
sam: quick sync: onboarding bugs keep popping because SDKs use different env vars for auth. can we agree a single convention + clear rotation semantics?
leila: yep. examples?
sam: node: REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ORG, python: REDWOOD_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT, go: REDWOOD_TOKEN. rotation tool currently only updates REDWOOD_API_KEY which leaves python/go clients using the old creds.
yves: annoying. security also wants a file-backed option so keys can live in mounted secrets/HSM proxies. propose naming: REDWOOD_API_KEY (inline token), REDWOOD_KEY_FILE (path to token file), REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT.
niraj: i like that. precedence we should mandate so all SDKs behave the same. my proposal:
- per-request Authorization header (highest)
- per-call sdk override (explicit param)
- env: REDWOOD_API_KEY
- file: REDWOOD_KEY_FILE (read contents)
- cloud metadata/service-account fallback
sam: also need hot-rotation semantics. rotation agent will atomically write new key to file and update envs in some containers. SDKs must: watch REDWOOD_KEY_FILE mtime and (1) auto-reload within 2s, and (2) expose reload_credentials() that operators can call after env change or SIGHUP.
yves: plus security rules: never log full key; mask in traces. telemetry must be opt-in and report only events like "key_rotated" with org/project ids, no key material.
leila: add compatibility shim: temporarily accept old env names (REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_TOKEN) for 90 days with a single WARN log to stdout/stderr, then drop. include migration guide in docs.
sam: sample pseudocode for README to keep parity across SDKs:
```
// resolve creds
if (request.headers.Authorization) return header.value
if (call.overrideApiKey) return call.overrideApiKey
if (ENV.REDWOOD_API_KEY) return ENV.REDWOOD_API_KEY
if (file.exists(ENV.REDWOOD_KEY_FILE)) return file.read(ENV.REDWOOD_KEY_FILE).trim()
return metadata.service_account_token()
```
niraj: we'll add unit tests for each branch and an integration test: rotation-bot writes new file to /var/run/redwood/org_<id>/key, then assert SDK instance picks it up in <2s. also add test for reload_credentials() call.
yves: also require SDKs to mask keys in error messages and to expose an event hook so apps can log key-change attempts (no secrets).
rotation-bot: [system] rotation job completed for org=org_456: new key written to /var/run/redwood/org_456/key, also set REDWOOD_API_KEY in ephemeral envs where supported.
leila: ops & infra: we'll need to update rotation-bot to write both REDWOOD_API_KEY (for simple containers) and REDWOOD_KEY_FILE for k8s/VMs, and coordinate rollout so shim mapping exists during transition window.
sam: next steps: niraj - open umbrella issue + PR templates for node/python/go; yves - security checklist + telemetry opt-in spec; leila - infra changes to rotation-bot + rollout plan; sam - docs + migration guide. target: deprecate old vars in 90 days, compatibility shim enabled for 14 days after rollout, warn-only for first week.
niraj: starting PRs today for node and python. i'll include file-watch util with configurable poll interval default 1s and reload API.
leila: great. ping in #devex when PRs land. thanks all :thumbsup:
